description: Implementation of a Direct3D 11 swap chain class for ANGLE, managing buffers, presentation, and related resources.

classes.name: SwapChain11
classes.description: A class managing a Direct3D 11 swap chain, buffers, and presentation logic for ANGLE.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases all resources associated with the swap chain.

methods.name: resetOffscreenBuffers
methods.description: Resets offscreen color and depth buffers to specified dimensions.

methods.name: resetOffscreenColorBuffer
methods.description: Creates or updates the offscreen color buffer texture and views.

methods.name: resetOffscreenDepthBuffer
methods.description: Creates or updates the offscreen depth buffer texture and views.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the swap chain buffers and related resources.

methods.name: getSwapChainNativeFormat
methods.description: Returns the DXGI format compatible with the current offscreen render target format.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Initializes or resizes the swap chain with specified dimensions and swap interval.

methods.name: initPassThroughResources
methods.description: Initializes shaders, buffers, and states for blitting operations.

methods.name: swapRect
methods.description: Performs buffer copy if needed and presents the swap chain, handling HDR color space if enabled.

methods.name: copyOffscreenToBackbuffer
methods.description: Copies the offscreen buffer to the backbuffer for presentation.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Presents the swap chain buffers to the display, handling different DXGI present methods.

methods.name: getOffscreenTexture
methods.description: Returns the current offscreen texture or the back buffer if offscreen is not used.

methods.name: getRenderTarget
methods.description: Returns the current render target view.

methods.name: getRenderTargetShaderResource
methods.description: Returns the shader resource view for the render target, creating a copy if necessary.

methods.name: getDepthStencil
methods.description: Returns the depth stencil view.

methods.name: getDepthStencilShaderResource
methods.description: Returns the shader resource view for the depth stencil.

methods.name: getDepthStencilTexture
methods.description: Returns the depth stencil texture.

methods.name: getKeyedMutex
methods.description: Returns the keyed mutex object for synchronization.

methods.name: recreate
methods.description: Placeholder for recreating the swap chain resources.

methods.name: getColorRenderTarget
methods.description: Returns the color render target object.

methods.name: getDepthStencilRenderTarget
methods.description: Returns the depth stencil render target object.

methods.name: getSyncValues
methods.description: Retrieves synchronization timing values from the swap chain.
